context: constraint: mirrors Rehearsal/Event schedule-then-record split (RehearsalService.ScheduleAsync + AttendanceService.RecordBatchAsync date guard)
constraint: reuses AgmAttendanceSheetService/AgmAttendanceSheetPdfRenderer from spec 018 rather than a new renderer
intent: Let AGMs be scheduled ahead of time (date + notes only) and recorded later, and let a blank attendance report print for a scheduled-but-unrecorded AGM, closing the gap spec 018 explicitly punted on.
expectations: Changes to the recorded-AGM report's PDF layout (two-column/checkbox styling) — that shipped in spec 018 and is reused as-is
Changes to the special-election (mid-term replacement) workflow
approach: Split IAgmService into ScheduleAsync (new, date+notes only) and a re-shaped RecordAsync(agmId, request) that completes an existing scheduled AGM, mirroring RehearsalService.ScheduleAsync + AttendanceService.RecordBatchAsync. A new AnnualGeneralMeeting.IsRecorded flag tracks state directly on the row; a new IAgmRepository.ExistsForYearAsync enforces one non-archived AGM per calendar year; the existing spec-018 AgmAttendanceSheetService/renderer is extended with an IsRecorded branch to print a blank all-unchecked report for scheduled AGMs.

decisions.decision: Add AnnualGeneralMeeting.IsRecorded (bool), not a nullable proxy field
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires state tracked directly on the row, not inferred from attendance-row presence; an AGM recorded with zero active members must still read as recorded (Edge Case 5)

decisions.decision: Enforce one-AGM-per-calendar-year via an app-level ValidationException check (IAgmRepository.ExistsForYearAsync), not a DB unique constraint
decisions.why: Matches this codebase existing convention (RecordAsync duplicate-assignment check is app-level too); single-user desktop SQLite app makes the race window irrelevant
decisions.rejected: A computed/persisted year column with a unique index

decisions.decision: Scheduled-AGM attendance sheet uses currently-active members (GetByStatusAsync), not active-as-of-the-AGM-date
decisions.why: Spec Edge Cases requires the printed roster to reflect membership at print time, not at scheduling time, since the AGM date can be far in the future

plan.summary: Full plan.md/research.md/data-model.md/contracts/ written: schedule-then-record split for IAgmService mirroring Rehearsals, new IsRecorded flag, ExistsForYearAsync uniqueness guard, extended AgmAttendanceSheetService for blank scheduled-AGM reports.
plan.key_finding: AgmAttendanceSheetService.GenerateAsync and AgmList/AgmDetail print handlers already exist from spec 018 and can be extended with an IsRecorded branch rather than building a new report pipeline.
